questions.question: Where do we get a legally usable, archived price history for NFL markets (opener and closer)?
questions.known: The NFL publishes no betting prices anywhere on nfl.com; game pages carry no odds values. The price snapshot store records opener/closer as blank on every market.
questions.not_known: Whether a licensed price archive can be obtained, at what cost, and on what terms it may be stored and republished.
questions.blocks: Every betting strategy; Gate G7 can never pass without a price.

questions.question: Which jurisdiction governs this project, and may derived lines be published?
questions.known: Responsible-gambling help is cited site-wide as good practice.
questions.not_known: The operating jurisdiction, any licence status, and whether publishing derived probabilities is permitted there.
questions.blocks: Any reward described as anything more than research points; S01 spend.

questions.question: Does the NFL publish an official depth chart?
questions.answer: No. https://www.nfl.com/depth-charts/ returns a 404 'Flag on the Play' page (re-checked 2026-11-14). No official source exists for a 1st/2nd/3rd/4th-string label.
questions.known: The official injury report gives per-player practice status and game status for clubs with a Week 10 game.
questions.blocks: It blocks depth-weighted rating (Q05) but is itself answered.

questions.question: Is there an official archive of past weeks' injury reports?
questions.known: nfl.com/injuries/ serves only the current week. This session's capture was partial (3 of 8 chunks).
questions.not_known: Whether any official historical snapshot exists at any price.
questions.blocks: Every historical injury backtest and every injury-adjusted line claim.

questions.question: How should a missing starter be converted into a points adjustment?
questions.known: The published designation (OUT / DOUBTFUL / QUESTIONABLE) is available. The league's injury-report policy explains what those words mean.
questions.not_known: Any measured conversion from 'player out' to points; needs snap counts and per-player value, neither published.
questions.blocks: Any depth-weighted rating. This site publishes a sensitivity band instead of a point estimate.

questions.question: Which clubs have a confirmed change to who actually starts?
questions.answer: Confirmed lineup changes named in official NFL.com reporting are captured per club where read (partial coverage). No string rank is published because no depth chart exists.
questions.known: Each change is transcribed with the article that states it (partial Week 10 capture).
questions.not_known: Whether any change is already reflected in a third-party line; full Week 10 census not reached.
questions.blocks: Nothing further within official-source limits.

questions.question: Does a model built only from archived scores beat the closing line?
questions.answer: No. Our rating model's expected home margin is computed from official standings only; it is a forecast, not a price. Because no closing price exists, the question can only be answered negatively by construction: there is no market to beat.
questions.known: All inputs official; model knobs frozen (model_ratings.json).
questions.blocks: Nothing; answered, and the answer is that the comparison cannot be made without a price (G7 blocked).

questions.question: What sample size is needed before a 55% hit rate is distinguishable from luck at -110?
questions.answer: Break-even hit rate is 110/210 = 52.38%. Detecting 55% against that null needs roughly n = 1,700 bets for 80% power at alpha 0.05. Every strategy tested here falls far short.
questions.known: The arithmetic is reproducible: z = (0.55 - 0.5238) / sqrt(0.5238*0.4762/n).
questions.blocks: Nothing; answered. This is why G1 exists.

questions.question: Are player-prop combos positively correlated enough to break independent pricing?
questions.answer: Dependence is measurable in principle; price is not. No official per-game player log exists, so QB/WR1 same-game dependence cannot be computed from official sources (C6 blank). No archived SGP price exists (C8 blank).
questions.known: The missing inputs are named rather than estimated.
questions.not_known: Any same-game prop correlation; the repriced SGP price.
questions.blocks: Any prop-combo strategy on the leaderboard.

questions.question: Can parlay legs from different games be multiplied as if independent?
questions.answer: Yes for cross-game legs: dependence between games is indistinguishable from zero (measured from official standings). Same-game legs are not independent (C5/C6).
questions.known: Cross-game dependence near-zero from official standings (n=32).
questions.blocks: Nothing for cross-game legs; within-game legs are C5/C6.

questions.question: What definition of 'skill' cannot be faked by re-running the search?
questions.known: Proposed: skilful only if it survives FDR across every test including placebos, has a week-clustered CI above zero, and earns <50% of profit in any single season.
questions.not_known: Whether the owner adopts this definition and whether it is strict enough.
questions.blocks: The reward design. A loose definition would pay for luck.

questions.question: Do the published numbers match an official source?
questions.answer: Yes where published. Standings: all 32 clubs read directly from nfl.com/standings/league/2026/REG on 2026-11-14 (sum W = sum L = 136; sum PF = sum PA = 6,291). Schedule and injuries read from nfl.com. Every table row links to its official page.
questions.known: Full standings transcription cross-checked (sum W=sum L).
questions.blocks: Nothing; answered.

questions.question: May third-party archives be redistributed on a public site?
questions.known: Any third-party archive used is labelled as such; licence terms not reviewed line by line.
questions.not_known: Whether the terms permit redistribution of derived values or the raw file.
questions.blocks: Any use beyond research and any redistribution of raw archive data.

questions.question: Can we obtain an official 2026 player-level box-score feed?
questions.known: nfl.com/stats/ presents player statistics in a client-rendered interface; no official download endpoint was established.
questions.not_known: Whether a licensed feed or official download endpoint exists.
questions.blocks: Any 2026 player-prop model and any prop strategy on the leaderboard.

questions.question: What exactly does a reward pay, and who funds it?
questions.known: Rewards are research points (pool of 1,000) precisely because no funding or legal basis exists to pay anything else.
questions.not_known: Whether a real reward is intended, its currency, or its funding source.

questions.question: Which single NFL dashboard is canonical?
questions.known: Sixteen NFL namespaces exist in the repository with heavy overlap.
questions.not_known: Which one the owner wants to keep, and whether the rest should be archived.

questions.question: Is the site live, and does it build without broken links?
questions.answer: This namespace builds as static HTML; verify.py fails on any broken local link or unsourced table row. Publication to GitHub Pages is via merge to main (to be confirmed in this session's PR).
questions.known: Local build and verification are part of this release.
questions.blocks: Nothing; answered.

questions.question: Is the archive's line column a closing price or an earlier-week snapshot?
questions.answer: No archive line is used here: no third-party line values are published on this site. All lines are our own originated forecasts from official standings.
questions.known: This site publishes only fair lines (forecasts); market lines are blank.
questions.blocks: Any precise claim about closing-line value (none made here).

questions.question: Does the injury adjustment change any originated line materially?
questions.answer: The injury adjustment is published as a band, not a point estimate, precisely because the input (game status only, no starter/snap count) cannot support precision. The published line is the no-adjustment line.
questions.known: Band published beside each game; disclosed assumption (multipliers 0.25/0.50/1.00 pts).
questions.blocks: Nothing; answered, and the answer bounds the claim.

questions.question: Are any rewards paid this snapshot?
questions.answer: No. 0 of 1,000 reward points are awarded; no strategy qualifies (G7 blocked, sample too small).
questions.known: Leaderboard published with zero qualifiers and zero rewards.
